snippet.title: Stonemachia - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Stonemachia is a small, zero-budget project created by Ivan Maestri with the help of a small Italian team called Crossfall Games. The game tells the story of Zefiro, a small chess pawn who will traverse the terrifying architectures of Medhelan in order to return to Heaven and kill Zerafim.

The game will initially be developed exclusively for PC, due to the lack of budget. If it performs well on this platform, we will do our best to bring it to consoles and translate it into as many languages as possible.

The voice actors heard in the trailer are Francesco Rizzi, Andrea Limonta, Luna Fogu, and Paolo Lombardi, who kindly dedicated their time to create a remarkable voice-over for some of the main characters.

Crossfall Games logo realized by Alessia Mozzaglia.

Follow Stonemachia for more!
